in_marathi.name: Janhita
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Janhita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Janhita is derived from the Sanskrit word 'jnana', meaning 'knowledge'. The prefix 'ita' means 'residing in'. Thus, Janhita is the name of a goddess who is believed to reside in the realm of knowledge.
